limits: Small package metadata exists only in latest12archives, so158 earlier engineversions remain unverified without binaryanalysis.
Public tagged model catalog is source for engine version, not proof of byte identity of bundled executable.
Remote model catalog and accountsettings may override bundled catalog; historical service/account defaults remain unknown.
Catalog source commit date, CLI publication date, desktop package date, and model availability date are distinct.
GPT-6-Sol is available but lower priority than GPT-6-Astra in examined September catalogs.
